mapper.select: select id, work_direction, cat_id, cat_name, pic_url, book_name, author_name, book_desc, book_status, is_vip, status, word_count, last_index_id, last_index_name, last_index_update_time from book where id = #{bookId} for update
mapper.update: update book set last_index_id = #{book.lastIndexId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, last_index_name = #{book.lastIndexName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_index_update_time = #{book.lastIndexUpdateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, word_count = #{book.wordCount}, update_time = #{book.updateTime} where id = #{book.id}
mapper.select: select id,crawl_source_id,crawl_book_id,crawl_last_time,pic_url,word_count from book where crawl_source_id is not null and crawl_source_id in (select id from crawl_source where source_status = 1) and (crawl_is_stop is null or crawl_is_stop = 0) and (crawl_last_time is null or crawl_last_time <= #{startDate}) and not exists ( select 1 from crawl_collection_state collection where collection.book_id = book.id and book.book_status = 1 and collection.source_id = book.crawl_source_id and collection.source_book_id = book.crawl_book_id and collection.source_completed = 1 and collection.collection_status = 'COMPLETE' and collection.expected_count > 0 and collection.ready_count = collection.expected_count and collection.missing_count = 0 and collection.unchecked_count = 0 and collection.failed_count = 0 and collection.deferred_count = 0 ) order by crawl_last_time limit #{limit}
select coalesce(sum(word_count), 0) from book_index where book_id = #{bookId}
